title: ci: lint.yml's scheduled run skips the battery when a green push run already covers the sha (3 of 3)
body:
Fixes #26071

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6416984681

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`lint.yml` 每 4 小时的定时运行新增第一个 job `schedule-gate`：同一 commit 上已有跑完且全绿的 push 运行时，其余 14 个 job（12 条 lane 和 2 个汇总）全部跳过；PR、合并队列、push、手动触发的行为不变。
- 为什么改：这是裁决 A 的第 (i) 步（(ii)(iii) 已在 #26512、#26570 落地）。定时运行测的是 main 的 head，而这个 commit 的 push 运行已经跑过同一套门禁。实测最近 13 次定时运行：push 运行最后都是绿的，但定时运行启动时已经跑完的只有 4 次。所以按裁决的写法，大约 4/13 会跳过，其余照常全量跑。
- 风险与回滚：门禁 job 一律偏向「照跑」：API 报错、403、读不懂返回、push 还在跑，都按「不跳过」处理；门禁 job 本身崩溃，各 lane 也照常运行。新增的风险面是 `check-required-contexts.mjs` 的一条接线断言，现在多接受一种精确拼写。回滚：revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`.github/workflows/lint.yml` 里的 `schedule-gate` job 和两个汇总 job（`lint`、`typecheck`）的 `if:`；`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` 的 `pinLanesCarryNoArrangeableIf`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:required-contexts && pnpm check:workflow-status-functions && pnpm check:pm-expected-skips`，应看到三组 ✓。合并后在 Actions 里看下一次 `Lint & Type Check` 定时运行：要么只有 `Schedule gate` 一个 job 在跑、其余显示 skipped，要么（push 还没跑完时）全量运行。
- 需要你做的：这是 Tier H（改 `.github/workflows/**`）。请审阅并 Approve，之后由席位落地。

## What changes

Step (i) of ruling 6416984681 (letter A), the last of the card's three serial PRs. Steps (ii) and (iii) landed as #26512 (`3fcafcd3`) and #26570 (`9bfd6a62`).

- **New first job `schedule-gate`** (`Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit`). Job-level `if: github.event_name == 'schedule'`, `permissions: actions: read` only, no checkout, `timeout-minutes: 10` (the file's job-wall floor). It runs one step, `gh api repos/REPO/actions/workflows/lint.yml/runs?event=push&branch=main&head_sha=SHA&status=completed&per_page=10`, and keeps only runs with `event == push`, `status == completed`, `conclusion == success` and `head_sha == github.sha`. It sets `skip=true` only on a positive match. Every other outcome sets `skip=false`: no run, a red run, a run on another sha, a failed read (403 included), or a body that does not parse. The step has no `set -e`, so a read failure cannot fail the job. If the job crashes anyway, its output reads empty and the lanes still run.
- **The 12 lanes** each gain the same two lines, `needs: [schedule-gate]` and `if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.schedule-gate.outputs.skip != 'true' }}`. On any event other than `schedule` the gate job is skipped and its output is the empty string. `!cancelled()` runs a job past a skipped or failed need, so each lane runs as before. This is ci.yml's existing `!cancelled() && needs.filter.outputs.*` idiom. No lane body changed: a yaml-parsed comparison against `HEAD` finds every job identical apart from `needs`/`if`.
- **The two required aggregates** (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`) keep `always()`. Each gains one schedule-only conjunct: `${{ always() && !(github.event_name == 'schedule' && contains(needs.*.result, 'skipped')) }}`. On any other event that conjunct is true, so `always()` decides exactly as before, and a skipped required context can never appear on a PR or a queue build. Their `needs:` and rosters are unchanged, so `check:aggregator-roster` and their run-time roster verdicts are unaffected.
- **`on:` comment block** now describes the skip, how it fails closed, and why ci.yml's schedule is not gated (there `push` tests the affected set only). The `schedule:` cron, the other triggers and the `concurrency:` key are byte-identical.
- **`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`**: the wiring assertion "the lane hosting the required-context pin must carry NO job-level `if:`" went red, because the pin lane (`lint-ci-engine`) now carries the skip. It now admits exactly one shape and still refuses every other `if:`. That shape is the lane's byte-exact skip `if:`, plus `needs:` on `schedule-gate`, plus a `schedule-gate` job whose `if:` is byte-exactly `github.event_name == 'schedule'`. There are six new self-test cases in both directions, and the battery floor rises from 13 to 23, its measured count (17 before, plus the 6). `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` is untouched.

Job-by-job, before → after. Before this PR every job ran on every event.

| job | push | pull_request | merge_group | workflow_dispatch | schedule, green push run already completed on the sha | schedule, none (or still running, red, unreadable) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `schedule-gate` (new) | skipped | skipped | skipped | skipped | runs, `skip=true` | runs, `skip=false` |
| 12 lanes (`Lint · *`, `Type Check · *`) | runs → runs | runs → runs | runs → runs | runs → runs | runs → **skipped** | runs → runs |
| `Lint & Repo Gates` (required) | runs → runs | runs → runs | runs → runs | runs → runs | runs → **skipped** | runs → runs |
| `TypeScript Type Check` (required) | runs → runs | runs → runs | runs → runs | runs → runs | runs → **skipped** | runs → runs |

## Tests

All local readings are on head `8fd56eab` (the final commit, after merging `origin/main` `5cba8fc2`).

<details><summary>Derived gate union: 61 of 61 exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; 2 paths vs merge base `5cba8fc2f`, 186 changed lines) derived 61 commands. All 61 ran with exit codes captured before any pipe, all 0. Among them: `check:required-contexts`, `check:workflow-status-functions` (58 job-level `if:`, 29 read `needs.*.outputs.*`, all naming a status function), `check:pm-expected-skips` (206 self-test cases), `check:aggregator-roster`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:shard-attestation`, `check:select-gate-families`, `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`, `check:nul-bytes`, and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 1935 cases). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: `61 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 61 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.

The first derivation, on the lint.yml-only commit, named 42 families. 41 were green and `check:required-contexts` was red with `wiring: the lane hosting the required-context pin must carry NO job-level if:`, which led to the gate change above.
</details>

<details><summary>Reverse verification on the live file (committed first, trap-restored)</summary>

Each mutation was made through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed), run against `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --self-test`, and restored with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` under an `EXIT INT TERM` trap.

- Leg A: the `schedule-gate` job's `if:` widened to `github.event_name != 'merge_group'` (the gate could now say skip on a PR): exit 1, `wiring: the lane hosting the required-context pin must carry NO job-level if: other than the scheduled-run skip`.
- Leg B: the pin lane's `if:` respelled `needs.schedule-gate.outputs.skip == 'false'`: exit 1, same finding.
- Leg C: the battery floor raised past its count: `registered 23 case(s), below its pinned floor of 999`. That shows the six new cases register, and the floor is now 23.
- Restore proof: `git hash-object` of both files equals the `HEAD` blob, `git diff HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` are empty, and the self-test exits 0 again.
</details>

<details><summary>The gate step's behaviour, offline and live</summary>

- Offline: the step's `run:` body was extracted from the parsed YAML and driven with a fake `gh` that applies the real `--jq` filter through `jq`. Results: green push run on the sha → `skip=true` (it picks the success run past a cancelled one on the same sha); red → `false`; success on another sha → `false`; empty listing → `false`; HTTP 403 → `false` (`the runs API did not answer (… HTTP 403)`); non-JSON body → `false`. The step exits 0 in all six cases.
- Live: the step's exact query, read against the 3 newest scheduled runs' shas, returns `total_count=1` with one green push run each; an all-zero sha returns `total_count 0`.
- YAML: `yaml` parse with no errors; `on` keys, `on.schedule` and `concurrency` are identical to `HEAD`. `actionlint`: NOT MEASURED, because it is not on PATH in this container.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/merge-queue-reporting.test.ts`, the one test file naming the edited gate script (in prose), ran under the verify lock: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 4 passed (4)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- No package source is touched, so no package build, test or typecheck is owed. `test:repo`, `pnpm lint` and whole-tree scans are CI's. No dogfood run: there is no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise P1, corrected by measurement.** The card measured that each of the 12 newest scheduled runs repeated a commit whose push run ended `success`, and that still holds for all 13 newest. But the ruled mechanism skips only on a **completed** green push run, checked when the scheduled run starts, and that holds for 4 of 13: `f708cf22`, `6390fe52`, `f143cd88`, `05f7758f`. In the other 9, the push run of the same commit finished 8 to 18 minutes after the scheduled run started (each push run's last job `completed_at` vs the schedule's `run_started_at`, 2026-10-26T06:25Z → 2026-10-28T04:14Z). A scheduled run starts late past its cron slot and `main` merges many times a day, so the head it tests is often a commit whose push run is still in flight. Those 9 run the full battery exactly as today; nothing is lost, only less is saved. Waiting for an in-progress push run would have skipped all 13, but that is a runner-spend shape the ruling did not name, so it is raised to the seat rather than built here.
- **What a skipped run reports.** The gate job succeeds and every other job is skipped, so the run's conclusion is expected to be `success`. The first post-merge scheduled run is the measurement. `scheduled-full-run.mjs --release-gate` reads the newest `schedule`/`push` run on the nearest commit. On a skipped commit that is either this run or the green push run of the same sha, so both answer `success`, as the battery did. `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` files only on `failure`/`timed_out` and is unaffected.
- **Live-state reads.** Gates in `lint-ci-engine` that read GitHub state (`issues: read`, `pull-requests: read`) are not re-read at schedule time on a skipped run. The next merge's push run re-reads them.
- **Scope.** The edit to `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` sits outside the claim's literal file surface ("a gate that reads that leg by name") but inside the dispatch's instruction to re-point what asserts on the changed shape. It touches only the wiring predicate and its self-test; `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` is unchanged. No other gate read the shape: the 61-family union is green.
- The file's ⭐ WHERE A GATE LIVES block still says every job runs on every `main` run. The scheduled skip is the one exception, stated in the `schedule-gate` header. The block itself was left unedited, per the scope fence.
- Region-disjoint from open draft #27067 (typecheck-workspace hunks near the turbo summarize lines): a local `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head with `b782ee2d` exits 0 and writes a tree. `lint.yml` is not routed to the custom merge driver.

## Verification

- Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`): the PR stays draft until an authorized approval. The seat lands it; nothing here readies, arms or enqueues it.
- CI on this PR runs the whole `lint.yml` (no paths filter). On `pull_request` the new `Schedule gate` check-run reads `skipped`, which `check-expected-skips` admits as `non-pr-event schedule; derived`. Every lane and both aggregates run as before.
